messages:
lina (AE): Heads up: TalusHealth renewal call tomorrow. They want to rebaseline from 500k -> 750k tokens/mo, asking for an across-the-board 15% discount, 60-day carryover and 90-day price lock. Also asking if we can offer a dedicated deployment pilot. Need deal desk + eng + finance input before I present.

omar (Sales Eng): We did a short smoke test on Dedicated last month. Latency improved ~22% p95. For 750k/mo I estimate a single A10040GB with autoscale headroom during peaks, but depends on their prompt lengths. I can run a quick distribution-weighted test tonight and post p50/p95/p99.

frida (Deal Desk): 15% is outside our standard for renewals unless they commit multi-year. Standard approach: give up to 12% for 12mo if they increase commit by 50% and accept carryover limits. Suggest proposal: 12% discount, 30-day carryover; if they sign 36mo, 15% + 60-day carryover. Need finance sign-off on price lock.

tess (CSM): Talus execs care about predictability. They prefer the Dedicated path if it means no throttling across teams. They asked for price protection for 90 days while they finalize budgets. We should be flexible but tie better discount to term length.

neal (Finance): 90-day price protection is doable but affects Q3 bookings recognition. If they want 15% now we need to model ARR impact; approve only with minimum annual ARR threshold. I can do a quick impact calc; need list price per 1M token and proposed committed volume.

sso-bot: SOC2 report: https://redwood.internal/reports/soc2-2025 (SSO access required)

frida (Deal Desk): Draft term to propose: 12mo term, 750k/mo commit, 12% off list, 30-day carryover, 90-day price protection conditional on payment terms; 36mo -> 15% but require finance OK and minimum ARR of $200k. Any objections?

lina (AE): Please put numbers in per-1M token unit so execs don't get confused. I will present provisional terms but call out finance/legal pending.

omar (Sales Eng): Quick per-1M calc: list = $4.00 per 1M. 12% off -> $3.52 per 1M. 0.75M/mo -> monthly spend = 0.75 * 3.52 = $2.64k -> annual = $31.68k. Will post perf numbers later.

neal (Finance): Maths checks. If they go to Dedicated pilot there will be a setup fee and potential monthly infra surcharge; include in ARR model. If they want HSM we'll need to add an enterprise add-on.

tess (CSM): I'll send the renewal invite for 9am PT tomorrow and include a dedicated pilot slide + provisional pricing. Lina, send me the slide by 8pm PT.

frida (Deal Desk): Flagging as deal-desk:provisional-approved pending finance signatures.

lina (AE): Thanks everyone. Omar - please post the p95/p99 by 7pm so I can drop into the deck. Neal - can you share the quick ARR impact calc in this thread when done?

omar (Sales Eng): Will post perf numbers and GPU sizing by 7:15pm PT.

neal (Finance): Posting quick model: list price $4/1M, 12% off -> $3.52. Monthly ARR = $2,640 -> Annual = $31,680. If Dedicated pilot adds $1,200/mo infra fee -> monthly $3,840 -> annual $46,080. Will follow up with detailed sheet.

lina (AE): Perfect. Locking this thread as the source of truth. Sending the call invite now.

frida (Deal Desk): No blockers from deal desk for the 12% proposal; final approval after finance/legal finalize.

neal (Finance): Will sign off by EOD after I review the SOW/infra fees.

omar (Sales Eng): Perf numbers attached in thread (link).

tess (CSM): Added Talus execs + procurement.

lina (AE): Closing prep. Thanks team :thumbsup:
